channel.title: somethingchan changelog
channel.description: release notes nobody reads, rendered by xslt.

item.title: v18.0.0 — plain html look
item.description: the ui is now plain html: times new roman, black on white, underlined blue links, grey default-looking buttons, 1px grey borders, left-aligned pages and a nav of plain links. every feature still works. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v17.0.0 — somethingsheets, and plainer
item.description: added /sheet/, a 360-cell spreadsheet with no javascript: editable cells, a name box and header highlights from generated :has(:focus) rules, filled/numeric counts from css counters, view toggles. prefilled with real measurements of this site. the ui is plainer and more boring: white pages, standard blue links, left-aligned headers, normal status colors. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v16.0.0 — docs, and quieter still
item.description: added /docs/: 12 techniques explained with html/css code tabs and live demos, a page-by-technique matrix, and a changelog stepper built from this feed. the ui is greyer: no accent colors, pictures in grayscale until hovered, no rounded corners or shadows, no decorative motion. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v15.0.0 — bland update
item.description: the whole ui is quieter now: muted greys, one plain font, thin borders, no glitch or tilt (css/bland.css, loaded last on every page). every feature still works. added /status/, a plain status page with 90-day uptime bars, incident history and metrics. javascript is listed as a component and is always blocked. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v14.0.0 — somethingwiki
item.description: added /wiki/, a wikipedia-shaped encyclopedia: 6 articles with talk, edit and history tabs, infoboxes, footnotes, hover previews, citation needed tooltips and a random article button made of 6 links cycling faster than you can see. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v13.0.0 — ddos map + secrets
item.description: added /map/, a fake live attack map: javascript-themed sources fire at somethingchan hq and the csp blocks every one. svg dot map, css arcs, smil packets, css counters. also added a secrets tab. it goes to the homepage. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v12.0.0 — somethingos
item.description: added /os/, a desktop made of html popovers: windows, taskbar, start menu, notepad, ms-dos prompt, recycle bin, image viewer, minesweeper with css win/lose detection, a css uptime clock and a recurring javascript.exe crash. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v11.0.0 — arcade update
item.description: added /arcade/: gem-tac-toe with css win detection on all 8 lines, whack-a-javascript with a css counter and a 30 second css timer, and the soy slots. new game buttons are html form resets. hosted by kara. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v10.0.0 — kara edition
item.description: kara eklund is now the official mascot. new /kara/ page with profile, filterable gallery and popover lightbox, and a hotspot map of her bag. she's the /qa/ admin now, she's in the favicon, and she shows up on every page. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v9.0.0 — the gem update
item.description: added /soy/, the gitjak soytionary: filterable terms, gem/coal voting with a css tally, a nooo-you-can't panel and a rosetta stone. soyspeak everywhere. new /qa/ thread. still 0 bytes of javascript. we're so back.

item.title: v8.0.0 — the hate update
item.description: added /shame/, the hall of javascript shame: rap sheet, framework graveyard, node_modules black hole, an npm install that never finishes, css-counted counters and a pledge. a javascript defender got banned on /qa/. the dungeon has a javascript goblin now. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v7.0.0 — imageboard edition
item.description: the faq is now /qa/, a css-only imageboard: threads, admin capcodes, greentext, quote previews, catalog view, three themes. added /ip/, where your ip bounces and dances. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v6.0.0 — lowercase edition
item.description: everything is lowercase now, even the comments. added /js, which shouts at browsers with javascript enabled, using zero javascript. added a css-only environment report.

item.title: v5.0.0 — kai edition
item.description: new look matching kaieklund.vercel.app. mit license (c) 2026 kai. added .git explorer, css clock, /qa/, code review simulator, museum of waiting. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v4.0.0 — the extreme update
item.description: added the lab (3d cube, pipeline, merge resolver, svg filters), rebase dungeon text adventure, 404 page, icalendar holidays, certificate svg. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v3.0.0 — the complexity update
item.description: added mathml, smil, xslt, popovers, image maps, and a csp that bans scripts outright.

item.title: v2.0.0 — css only
item.description: removed javascript that never existed. added flip cards.

item.title: v0.0.1 — pre-history
item.description: epoch. the void. a lone .git folder.
